fight.modalHelpTextHtml:
Within the allocated time, choose actions for attack and defense.


Available actions:

  • HD (Head Defence): head defense
  • BD (Body Defence): body defense
  • HH (Head Hit): head hit
  • BH (Body Hit): body hit

After selecting actions, a comparison with the opponent's actions occurs. The winner is the one who lands more hits and receives fewer.


Example:

You: HD, HH, BD

Opponent: HH, BD, BH

Result: you landed 1 hit, blocked 2 of the opponent's hits. Winner: You


Important: You cannot select all actions as attacks or all as defenses. One of the actions must be the opposite.
